note.zh-TW: 教材英文寫 interest guarantee，不是通用說法，列為別名；課程的門檻只當「課程參考值」顯示，不計分（設計說明見 T24）。
note.en: The course's English term interest guarantee is not standard usage and is kept as an alias; the course threshold is shown only as a course reference value and is not scored (see the design note T24).

definition.zh-TW: 扣利息與所得稅前的獲利是利息費用的幾倍，看公司賺的錢夠不夠付利息。倍數越高，付息越沒有壓力。
definition.en: Profit before interest and tax as a multiple of interest expense: whether earnings comfortably cover the interest bill. A higher multiple means less strain.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
